hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.py) command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff check --quiet "$f" 2>&1 | head -40 ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$ROOT" ] && exit 0; cd "$ROOT/frontend" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; if [ -f .eslintrc.json ] || [ -f .eslintrc.js ] || [ -f eslint.config.js ] || [ -f eslint.config.mjs ]; then npx --no-install eslint --quiet "$f" 2>&1 | head -40; fi ;; esac; }
